title: fix(types,cli): the three plugin-ai node types validate, and a ratchet counts the registered types `objectui validate` refuses (objectui#10859, batch 1)
body:
Part of #10859
Clause-②: yes

Batch 1 of the family card. Status: **draft, green locally at head `29ac3c78ec`** — seat ruling 5861220023 (option B) is applied: objectui#10821 merged at 2026-09-28T01:41Z, `origin/main` `b93e245f94` is merged in (a merge commit, `5d0333649e`, no rebase, no conflicts), and the mirror-parity census rows are registered (see "Applied"). The measurement sections are read at `d7d5bca32a`; the two fix rounds (`2e967aeef6`, `adec9c60ff`) changed a ledger, a docblock, a changeset sentence and a test header, and the census round (`29ac3c78ec`) the parity test; "Gates" says what was run on each head.

## What changed

- **`packages/types/src/zod/ai.zod.ts` (new).** Zod mirrors of the three `@object-ui/plugin-ai` node declarations in `packages/types/src/ai.ts` — `AIFormAssistSchema`, `AIRecommendationsSchema`, `NLQuerySchema` — plus their sub-schemas `AIConfigSchema`, `AIFieldSuggestionSchema`, `AIRecommendationItemSchema`, `NLQueryResultSchema`, and the category union `AIComponentSchema`.
- **`packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts`.** The eight are exported on the `./zod` barrel, and `AIComponentSchema` joins `AnyComponentSchema`'s arm list. One live prose count in the recursion-point docblock ("14 modules import ... all 13 category modules") is rephrased without a number.
- **`packages/types/src/zod/README.md`.** "Available Schemas" gains an "AI Components (3)" group.
- **Pins:** `packages/types/src/__tests__/ai-zod-arms-10859.test.ts` (type-level parity plus runtime acceptance and refusal rows) and the ratchet `packages/cli/src/__tests__/registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts`.
- **`packages/types/src/__tests__/ai-insights-retired-8800.test.ts` — a leg this change falsified, re-derived.** Its PREMISE leg read "no `ai.zod.ts` exists" as its proxy for "the `ai-insights` retirement has one face". The leg now reads what the retirement rests on: `ai.zod.ts` declares no `ai-insights` arm and the zod barrel exports no `AIInsightsSchema`, with the sibling it does carry as the lit control. The header note is the contract review's dated text (review 5861335842, item 4): it says why the `in ZodFace` probe is not the fourth instrument the header rules out, and keeps the sentence recording the old tree. (File-surface addition beyond the claim; it goes red otherwise.)
- **`packages/types/src/zod/base.zod.ts`, the `SchemaNodeSchema` docblock** (review item 2). "all 13 category modules, and 14 modules import THIS one" — falsified by this PR — now reads "every category module, and each of those modules imports THIS one"; measured, all 14 category modules import `base.zod.js`.
- **`scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs`** (review item 1). Two `ADJUDICATED` rows, one per new pin: each reads `packages/plugin-ai/README.md`; `notRead` records the root README and the pin's own package README, which are the scanner's ancestor resolutions of the bare `README.md` path segment. An `fs` trace of each file's run opened that one README and no other markdown.
- **`packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`** (census round, on the landed ledgers of objectui#10821). The seven `ai.zod.ts` pairs in `MIRRORS` / `Declared` (`EXPECTED_MIRROR_PAIRS` 162 → 169); `ai.zod.ts#AIComponentSchema` in `EXCLUSIONS`; three per-pair `KnownDrift` entries carrying the five `on*` keys, with the header's `KnownDrift` figures (46 / 84 → 49 / 89) and the ratchet section's restatement (46 → 49) moved and a movement sentence citing objectui#10859 in each. No other ledger row.
- **Changesets.** `.changeset/10859-ai-node-zod-arms.md` (`'@object-ui/types': minor`, the `Clause-②: yes` line, no BREAKING banner). Its last sentence is the review's (item 3): an authored handler string was never a working handler, delete the key, and the TS face's `string` typing is objectui#10874's. Dated notes, objectui#10533 form, frontmatter byte-identical, on four pending entries this change moves — see Acceptance notes.

## M1 — the 79, reproduced on `main`

`safeValidateSchema({ type: KEY })` over the 229 bare keys of `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES`, on `origin/main` `a60539b07`: **79 refused**, every one with exactly one issue, `invalid_union` at path `type` (issue-shape histogram: 79 × one-issue-at-`type`; the other 41 refusals are arms that want a required member and are not at `type`). Lit control: `timeline` accepted. The 79:

`ai-form-assist` `ai-recommendations` `app-creation-wizard` `app-schema-renderer` `auto_number` `boolean` `branding-editor` `checkboxes` `color` `currency` `dashboard-editor` `dashboard-grid` `data-model-designer` `date` `datetime` `detail-section` `donut-chart` `embeddable-form` `field-designer` `file` `form-analytics` `formula` `geolocation` `home` `import-wizard` `location` `lookup` `master_detail` `metric` `metric-card` `multiselect` `navigation-designer` `navigation-renderer` `nl-query` `number` `object` `object-manager` `object-master-detail-form` `object-metric` `object-pivot` `object-timeline` `page-designer` `page-header` `percent` `phone` `pie-chart` `pivot` `process-designer` `qrcode` `radar-chart` `radio` `rating` `record` `related-list` `report-designer` `responsive-grid` `richtext` `scatter-chart` `shared-view-link` `sidebar-content` `sidebar-footer` `sidebar-group` `sidebar-header` `sidebar-inset` `sidebar-menu` `sidebar-menu-button` `sidebar-menu-item` `sidebar-provider` `sidebar-trigger` `signature` `spec-report` `summary` `tags` `tree` `url` `user` `utility` `vector` `view`

End to end, the **base** `objectui validate` binary (`packages/cli/dist/cli.js`, built on `a60539b07`) on the README's `{ "type": "ai-form-assist", "showConfidence": true, "showReasoning": true }`, exit 1:

```text
✗ Schema validation failed!

Validation Errors:

1. Invalid input
   Path: type
   Code: invalid_union
   No arm accepts type "ai-form-assist".
```

The **head** binary on the same file, exit 0: `✓ Schema is valid!` / `Type: ai-form-assist`.

| (ii) no declaration, taught or offered — owes a declaration and an arm | 28 |
| (iii) proposed not-authorable — the seat rules | 30 |
| unclear — evidence both ways | 9 |

Criteria used. (i): an exported declaration whose `type` member is the literal KEY and which describes the NODE (extends `BaseSchema`, or is `@objectstack/spec`'s `ComponentPropsMap` row for KEY). A `FieldMetadata` interface carrying `type: 'number'` describes a `fields[]` entry, not a node, and is read as (iii) evidence below. Teaching sites: `content/**`, `docs/**` (ADRs and audits excluded), `skills/**`, `examples/**`, `packages/*/examples/**` and every package `README.md`, matched on a `type` key carrying the literal or on the key named in backticks. "PUBLIC_BLOCKS" is ADR-0080's curated AI-authoring roster, `packages/core/src/registry/public-blocks.ts`.

## M3 — the strict face

`StrictAnyComponentSchema` is `z.lazy(() => faceWalker(AnyComponentSchema))` in `packages/types/src/strict-authoring-face.ts`: it derives its arms from `AnyComponentSchema` and needs no separate edit. At head the three minimal documents, the README document and a fully populated document of each type are accepted by it (rows "X is accepted by the strict authoring face"), and it refuses an undeclared member on an AI arm with `unrecognized_keys` naming the key (the strictness control). The tolerant face keeps `.passthrough()`, as for every arm.

## The arms

- Member for member with `ai.ts`: `assertionKeySetsAgree` (type-level, invariant Equal) holds the key set of each arm and sub-schema equal to its declaration's — none added, none dropped — and `assertionMemberTypesAgree` holds each member's accepted type equal to the declaration's.
- House conventions: `BaseSchema.extend`; plain `z.object` for sub-schemas (no index signature on the declarations); the seven objectui#8178 `?: never` members are `retirementTombstone`s; both content channels are objectui#9256 family-D tombstones; `.describe()` strings from the declarations' JSDoc; no `.default()`.
- **The one divergence, pinned both ways.** The five `on*` members are `string` on the TS face — the handler-expression string dialect objectui#6182 withdrew on EITHER face. The census in `handler-keys-string-any-mirrors-7344.test.ts` refuses any `on*: z.string(` line in `packages/types/src/zod/`, so the arm follows objectui#6124 with `handlerKeyRefusal`, disposition measured on `@object-ui/plugin-ai`: `onSelect`, `onDismiss` (`AIRecommendations`) and `onSubmit` (`NLQueryInput`) are RUNTIME SLOTS — the raw component is registered, `SchemaRenderer` spreads node keys onto it, and it calls the prop; `onApplySuggestion` and `onRejectSuggestion` have no reader and are RETIRED. `assertionHandlerDivergence` pins the TS members still `string | undefined` and the zod members `undefined`, so repairing `ai.ts` reddens the pin. `ai.ts` is not edited here (reported below).

## Pins, red on base and green on head, and the ablation

Base = a detached worktree at `a60539b07` with the two new test files copied in; head = `d7d5bca32a`. Commands from the repo root: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/src/__tests__/ai-zod-arms-10859.test.ts packages/cli/src/__tests__/registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts` (plus `ai-insights-retired-8800.test.ts` at head and under the ablation).

| run | result |
|---|---|
| base | `Test Files 2 failed (2)` · `Tests 28 failed / 2 passed (30)` — every acceptance, README, `objectui validate`, tombstone, handler, channel, strictness row and the ratchet red; the two instrument controls green |
| head | `25 passed` + `5 passed` (+ `8 passed` for the amended 8800 pin) |
| ablation: `AIComponentSchema` removed from `AnyComponentSchema`'s list | `Tests 28 failed / 10 passed (38)` — the 8800 pin and the ratchet's two controls stay green |

⚠️ The order predicted that only the acceptance rows and the ratchet redden. Observed: every row that reaches an AI arm THROUGH the root union reddens — the tombstone, handler, channel and strictness rows too — because they parse via `safeValidateSchema` and, with no arm, all refuse at `type` instead. Rows that read the arms directly (the type-level parity block) are not runtime rows. The ratchet's message under the ablation: `` `objectui validate` refuses 79 registered bare key(s) at `type`; the pin is 76. `` followed by the MORE-than-the-pin guidance and the refused list.

Resolution path: the vitest config aliases `@object-ui/types/zod` and `@object-ui/types` to `src/`, so both new files measure source, not `dist/`; no build sits between mutation and reading. Mutation and restore went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack): anchor 1 → 0, blob changed, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty.

Type-level reverse validation, same tool, `tsc -p packages/types/tsconfig.test.json`: `showConfidence` retyped to `z.string()` → exit 2, `TS2344 Type 'false' does not satisfy the constraint 'true'` on the member-types row; `emptyMessage` deleted → exit 2, the same error on the key-set row. Both restored.

## The ratchet

`packages/cli/src/__tests__/registered-types-validate-ratchet-10859.test.ts` — in `packages/cli` because `@object-ui/cli` depends on `@object-ui/types` and owns `KNOWN_SCHEMA_TYPES`. It counts the bare registry keys `safeValidateSchema({ type })` refuses with `invalid_union` at `type` and asserts the count equals `REFUSED_AT_TYPE = 76` (79 on `main`, minus this batch's three). Below the pin it tells the next batch to lower it; above it, never to raise it; it prints the refused keys either way. Non-vacuity: the population is over 200 keys and contains `timeline`; `timeline` is not refused, `chart` fails but not at `type`, an invented key is refused. The same file runs `objectui validate` on the README document in-process (the `validate-union-arm-selection.test.ts` harness) and expects `Schema is valid`, exit 0.
